Needs changes before merge.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3008` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport.rs:201`: The PR changes AI turn undo and confirmation behavior. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add images that show the changed undo behavior and the machine-edit confirmation. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit review images to this PR branch.

The grouped commands undo in reverse order. The approval check binds the tool name and arguments. The UI passes selection data through the app API.

Local results:

- Tested head `f37a111680aa81220db4873f202318269f8be81c` against `upstream/main` at `e808c96299ef7e1edb3206d327acc270847a8a18`. The trial merge reported `Already up to date.`
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test batch_undo --test mcp_live --test mcp --test mcp_provider --no-run`: passed.
- The four app suites passed: `batch_undo` 3, `mcp_live` 14, `mcp` 22, and `mcp_provider` 9.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --test commands_undo`: 355 library tests and 30 command tests passed. One library test was ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 968 passed, 6 ignored.
- App clippy passed with `--lib --bins --test batch_undo --test mcp_live --test mcp --test mcp_provider -- -D warnings`.
- UI clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Combined clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` failed in the unchanged `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs`. This file is identical to upstream main. The compiler reported:

```text
error[E0308]: mismatched types
   --> crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:107:19
expected `Option<WorkMaterial>`, found `WorkMaterial`

error[E0063]: missing fields `stepdown` and `stepover` in initializer of `camcraft_app::tool_cutting_rows::CuttingRow`
   --> crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106:15
```

Safety checks:

- Bypassed `LiveGate::check`. `live_permission_gate_blocks_unapproved_post_file_writes_paths_and_machine_limits` failed because an unapproved post wrote `blocked.nc`. Restored the source. The test passed.
- Made `GateKind::allows_auto_approve` return `true`. `live_gate_allows_explicitly_approved_calls_and_never_auto_approves_post_or_machine_edits` failed because posting was auto-approved. Restored the source. The test passed.
- No G-code, CL, or golden files changed. There were no moved goldens to compare.
- The review worktree has no remaining tracked changes.

The quick gate plan was read with `--dry-run`. The full quick gate, batch gate, release gate, and external LLM API calls were not run. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
